shortDescription: RSSB Junior Engineer Online Form 2026. Verify the latest notice on rsmssb.rajasthan.gov.in before you apply, download or treat a result as final.
content:
Rajasthan Staff Selection Board is accepting (or has reopened) online applications for Junior Engineer.

Read the detailed advertisement for eligibility, fee, dates and district/post-wise vacancies before you submit the form.

How to apply

  1. Open rsmssb.rajasthan.gov.in
  2. Complete registration / OTR if required
  3. Fill the form, upload documents and pay the fee
  4. Print the confirmation page
editorNotes: Independent listing for candidates. NaukriMitra is not a government website. Always open the official recruiting-body URL before paying a fee or relying on a result.
importantInstructions: Do not share login OTPs. Download PDFs only from the official domain. Dates and vacancy counts on aggregator sites can lag behind the notice.

faqs.question: Where can I verify RSSB Junior Engineer Online Form 2026?
faqs.answer: Use the official website: https://rsmssb.rajasthan.gov.in. This page only points you there.

faqs.question: Are the dates on this page final?
faqs.answer: No. Treat every date as a prompt to re-check the latest PDF or login dashboard on the official portal.

faqs.question: What should I keep ready?
faqs.answer: Photo, signature, educational certificates, category certificate (if any) and valid photo ID
